rule: Background 0. Every isolated single-pixel marker of colour 2/3/5/8 is replaced, on a blank canvas, by a fixed 4x4 motif anchored at its top-left and clipped to the grid: 2 -> hollow square in 4, 3 -> ring in 1, 5 -> diagonal 2x2 blocks in 6, 8 -> X in 7. An optional legend is a full motif in its motif colour, with its key marker diagonally past its bottom-right corner. The legend and key are erased and not stamped. An ordinary 3-marker sitting in a ring legend's empty corner (pair 2) is still stamped.
scope: Supported: regular lattices (step 4..7) and irregular lattices (gaps 4..gmax), any offset below the step or gmax, random density and palette subsets, clipped stamps at the right and bottom edges, a legend that is optional (75% by default) and either on-lattice or free, and the pair-2 ring-corner 3 for on-lattice and off-lattice ring legends. Random sides are 10..30; non-square grids and sides above 20 are synthetic extensions. The explicit marker/legend path accepts sides 1..30 and rebuilds all fixtures. Deliberately not supported: multiple legends, overlapping stamp boxes, touching markers, non-zero backgrounds, and legends whose key colour is absent from the ordinary markers in random scenes.

0 is the strict majority colour of the input
